page.overview:
Who is Rappa?

Rappa has Nappa's facial features and facial hair, but with Raditz's long spiky hair and black and brown Battle Armor. Unlike his Fusion Dance counterpart, Rappa lacks a Scouter and wears a Metamo-Ring on his left forearm. He also possesses a Saiyan Tail which he wraps around his waist just like both his fusee do.

Like his fusees, Rappa is a proud and brutish Saiyan warrior. He seems happy about his increased power gained as a result of being a fusion.

As EX-Fusions is weaker than fusions produced by the Metamoran Fusion Dance, presumably Rappa is weaker than his Fusion Dance counterpart, Natz. However, Rappa has the advantage of not being bound by a time limit as he can remain fused as long as he continues to wear his Metamo-Ring, while Natz can only maintain his fusion for half an hour, thus while he may be weaker in terms of power, he can remain fused much longer than Natz.

Like Natz, Rappa is a B-Rank fighter which makes his EX-Fusion weaker than the likes of EX Gotenks, EX Yamhan, Bulpan, Pandel, Dodobon, and Turtz who are all A-Rank.
